scope: Held-out exploratory evaluation, partial-view point clouds, grab affordance only
query_conditions: Point to the part you would grasp.
Identify the region suitable for gripping.
Locate where you would grip the object.
ensemble: Arithmetic mean of the three sigmoid score maps, pointwise
sample_selection: Among validation partial views, retain the first occurrence of each unique shape ID with at least one ground-truth grab point; exclude all shape IDs used in E09 and E10; rank the remaining IDs by SHA256("E11-grab:" + shape_id) and select the first 20. Selection uses ground-truth label availability only, not predictions.
metric: Affogato/Espresso source sample_metrics; aIoU 20 thresholds [0,1], AUC, SIM, MAE
claim_limit: Selected for positive grab labels; 20 unique shapes; different from E09/E10 objects. This is exploratory and not a representative benchmark. The model is an unofficial Espresso-3D implementation with Affogato-pretrained weights applied to OpenAD partial views; no Affostruction inference was run.
baseline_query: Point to the part you would grab.
